coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned PoDoFo PDF tokenizer, object parser, cross-reference parser, and PdfMemDocument loader
parser_family: PoDoFo PDF parser; an independent C++ PDF parser with its own tokenizer, object parser, and cross-reference reader, distinct from Poppler, qpdf, and MuPDF. Pdfmm is a PoDoFo fork and shares this lineage
